mapper.insert: insert into anime (title, original_title, cover, type, genre, episodes, status, year, rating, synopsis) values (#{title}, #{originalTitle}, #{cover}, #{type}, #{genre}, #{episodes}, #{status}, #{year}, #{rating}, #{synopsis})
mapper.select: select id, title, original_title, cover, type, genre, episodes, status, year, rating, synopsis, created_at, updated_at from anime ORDER BY id DESC
